estimates.assumptions: Handful of sea salt (≈15-20g); nutritional contribution negligible as most is brushed off before cooking
4 cloves garlic (≈12g total); raw weight used
Handful of fresh thyme (≈10-15g); nutritional contribution negligible
4 duck legs (≈1400g total raw with skin/bone); values based on typical whole-leg composition including rendered fat released during cooking
100ml white wine; standard dry white wine values, alcohol mostly evaporates but calories retained
